_note: Synthetic 8-clause warranty policy for a demo.

clauses.title: General coverage
clauses.text: Defects in materials or workmanship are covered for 24 months from the sale date.

clauses.title: Battery pack and battery controller
clauses.text: The battery pack and battery controller are covered for 36 months or 30,000 km from the sale date, whichever comes first.

clauses.title: Drive unit
clauses.text: Motor and inverter are covered for 24 months from the sale date.

clauses.title: Cooling system
clauses.text: Coolant pump, radiator and hoses are covered for 24 months from the sale date.

clauses.title: Software
clauses.text: Firmware defects fixed by a published service bulletin are covered at no charge for the life of the vehicle.

clauses.title: Exclusion: impact damage
clauses.text: Damage caused by a crash or impact is not covered. An impact above 6 g recorded within 60 s before the first fault counts as impact damage.

clauses.title: Exclusion: water from pressure washing
clauses.text: Water ingress caused by pressure washing at the charge port or electrical connectors is not covered.

clauses.title: Exclusion: wear and modifications
clauses.text: Wear items (tyres, chain, sprockets, brake pads) and owner modifications are not covered.
